{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert `revenue` from string to float after removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and exclude the 6 internal QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
# We do this before filtering for loyal and completed
filtered_sales = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Now filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = filtered_sales[(filtered_sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (filtered_sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue for this subset
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

mean_revenue"}
